title: mw.txn.request.v1
description: Transaction request from a channel service to mw-orchestrator (spec 5.1, 6.2). Key: txnId. Consumers ignore unknown fields; only additive changes within v1.

originalTxnId.description: Set for REVERSAL: the transaction being compensated.

assertion.description: mw-auth's transaction authorisation assertion for this request (spec 18.7, D22), obtained by the channel with exactly this request's txnType, amount, debitParty, creditParty, idempotencyKey and channel (its txnHash); the orchestrator copies it with the idempotencyKey into ValidateTransaction, HoldFunds and PostTransfer. Every customer-authorised request carries one (the core refuses a transfer without it); bulk children and reversals carry none. No PIN or PIN ciphertext ever travels on this topic (the core PIN scheme M11 was removed in ticket 72).

metadata.description: Channel extras (device ID, USSD session, IP); masked by policy.

attributes.description: Product-specific data (bill number, meter number, account number).

allOf.description: BALANCE (ADR D26) moves no money: amount 0 (checked by mw-orchestrator), both parties the customer's own wallet (creditParty = debitParty, checked by mw-orchestrator), and mw-auth's assertion.
